intro: Over 24 articles published between April 12 and April 30, 2026, ZCyberNews tracked activity tagged law-enforcement. The coverage included 19 high-severity and 4 medium-severity incidents, with one informational report. Threat actors Scattered Spider, Black Axe, and BlackCat (ALPHV) were observed. Affected sectors spanned government, telecommunications, financial services, cryptocurrency, and gaming, while impacted regions included the United States, Canada, North America, Europe, and France.
